About Apple Sunset

Apple Sunset tracks how long it's been since every current Apple product was last updated, so you can tell at a glance whether now's a good time to buy or worth holding off.

It isn't trying to replace Apple's own site or the Apple news sites, there's no reviews or rumours here beyond a short note where relevant. It's simply a countdown for what's current and a searchable archive for what's been discontinued, one place to check either.

It's an independent project and isn't affiliated with Apple.

How to read the numbers

Days since refresh
How long it has been since Apple last released a new version of a product, counted from its most recent release date.
The usual wait
The average gap between a product’s past releases, shown once it has at least two. “1.2× the usual wait” means this wait is already 20% longer than its average.
The colours
Each product is measured against its own usual wait, not a fixed number of days: green for under half of it, amber from half to the full wait, and red once it has gone past it. A product with only one release so far is measured against a typical gap for its family.
Release history
Every recorded release of a product and its family, on a timeline on each product and family page.
Discontinued
Products Apple no longer sells stay on the site in a searchable archive, with their full release history.
